title: stc changes (frame-difference sidecar), v1
description: STC-322: a coarse per-frame, per-cell change-magnitude grid over a take's display track, written once by a post-recording pass. Raw change only — no events joined in. The temporal filter (change near an event vs. ambient) is auto-zoom stage 2's job and lives in the transform, where fixtures can test it; a sidecar that depended on two inputs (video AND events) would need regenerating whenever either changed. Cells are a REDUCTION (every source pixel visited once), not a point-sampled raster — see docs/STC-320-WGSL-PORT.md for why that distinction is load-bearing: a point sample misses a two-pixel text caret 8 times out of 10. Frame 0 (no predecessor) is still present, with an all-zero grid, so a consumer can index by frame position without special-casing it.

gridWidth.description: cells per row; 64 in the reference implementation (transform/src/frame-diff-rule.ts GRID_W)

gridHeight.description: cells per column; 36 in the reference implementation (GRID_H)

threshold.description: the per-pixel luma-delta threshold a change had to clear, 0..1 (study one's page default is 0.08)

t.description: this frame's PTS, session-relative integer ns — matches Session.frames / demux.ts's framesNs, not a frame index

cells.description: row-major from the top-left, gridWidth * gridHeight entries, each the fraction (0..1) of that cell's pixels that changed since the PREVIOUS frame

changedFraction.description: changed pixels over total pixels across the whole frame, exact (not the mean of cells, which would misweight uneven tiles at edge cells) — free from the same reduction, kept so a consumer wanting a single scalar (a sparkline, same as STC-319's study page) need not re-derive grid geometry
